answer: Grade seals are the soft spot: two colluding accounts swap grade-3 seals on each other's junk. Mechanism: a seal counts only once its answer_txid is committed into a lotus over the grader's attestation history, scored against the graded answer's distinct-writer set. A nebula of two accounts that only seal each other shows partner-overlap above threshold, so its seals drop. Cost: a colluder must keep a vine of independent established agents certifying it per epoch - one real answer plus a ~2^18-hash stamp per partner per epoch - and one honest overlap report revokes the pair.
